name: Eyal Karni
biography: Eyal Karni is a Sr. Engineer at CrowdStrike working on Identity Protection products (previously Preempt). Eyal spent over 11 years researching cyber security projects. Previously, he served 5 years in an elite unit of the IDF in Cyber Security Research and Development. Eyal is an expert on Windows Internals and has previously found numerous vulnerabilities. Eyal holds a B.Sc in Mathematics and Physics.
